transcript: Speaker A (Narrator): रात 10:00 बजे से सुबह 6:00 बजे तक गेट पर बैठता हूं। 8 घंटे। कोई नहीं आता, कोई नहीं जाता। एक दिन एक लड़के ने कहा, 'अंकल, ये 8 घंटे बर्बाद मत करो, अंग्रेजी सीखो।' उस रात से सब बदल गया। [I sit at the gate from 10 PM to 6 AM. 8 hours. No one comes, no one goes. One day a boy said, 'Uncle, don't waste these 8 hours, learn English.' Everything changed since that night.] ... Speaker B (Wife): कुछ करो, लड़की की उम्र निकल रही है! [Do something, the girl is getting older!] ... Speaker C (Interviewer): Can you maintain a visitor log and coordinate with the admin team? ... Speaker D (Rohit): अंकल, आप रोज 8 घंटे यहाँ बैठे रहते हो खाली। ये 8 घंटे में अंग्रेजी सीख सकते हो। English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Uncle, you sit here idle for 8 hours daily. You can learn English in these 8 hours. Download the English Seekho app.] ... Speaker A (Narrator): ओम प्रकाश ने English Seekho ऐप से अंग्रेजी सीखी और कॉर्पोरेट पार्क में ₹22,000 की नौकरी पा ली। [Om Prakash learned English with the English Seekho app and got a job of ₹22,000 at a corporate park.]

summary: A 55-year-old night security guard earning a low salary is advised by a young resident to utilize his idle night shift hours to learn English. Using the English Seekho app, he improves his communication skills, successfully clears a corporate job interview, and triples his income. This allows him to proudly fund his daughter's wedding without financial dependency.
